card.text: Explore Tethys in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect Cassini imagery and elevation maps of Saturn’s icy moon, Odysseus crater, and Ithaca Chasma.

introduction.text: An icy moon of Saturn marked by the enormous Odysseus crater and Ithaca Chasma, a vast canyon crossing its surface. The shape view reveals a simplified Cassini SPC model. Relative albedo shows the model’s brightness variation; elevation uses its own stated reference sphere.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Source pixels span 293 m in the 2012 mosaic. Shadows and uneven detail remain; the gray grid marks missing observations.

enhanced.title: Enhanced-color composite
enhanced.summary: Infrared, green and ultraviolet bands reveal colors beyond human vision. Detail varies; photographed shadows and seams remain.

iss.title: Cassini ISS narrow-angle image
iss.summary: One Cassini photograph from 190,000 km, projected onto the shape model. Grid marks unphotographed or shadowed surface.

elevation.title: SPC terrain model
elevation.summary: Color shows height above the PDS 531 km reference sphere. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief lighting at true height scale; Shadows adds the shared approximate globe lighting. Cassini SPC model released in 2025, about 1.5 km grid spacing. The globe uses a simplified version of the released Q128 shape; grid and geometry resolutions differ. Model detail and accuracy vary.

relative-albedo.title: SPC relative brightness model
relative-albedo.summary: Relative brightness solved together with the Cassini SPC shape model, normalized around 1. This secondary model product is less validated than topography. It is neither visible color nor calibrated reflectance. Colors show 0.5–1.5; values above 1.5 saturate. Gray grid preserves source gaps.

shape.title: SPC shape model
shape.summary: Neutral grid over a simplified source shape, without photographic texture or height exaggeration. Source model detail and accuracy vary. Cassini SPC Q128 model released in 2025. The 2,000-face view retains broad shape; small terrain details are omitted.

infrared.title: Cassini VIMS regional spectra · 2007–2015
infrared.summary: Cassini false color: red 2.02, green 1.59, blue 1.28 µm. Coverage is partial; gray grid marks gaps. Illumination and archive filtering remain in these uncorrected measurements.

ice-absorption.title: Cassini VIMS regional water-ice absorption · 2007–2015
ice-absorption.summary: Near-2.02 µm water-ice absorption in partial Cassini coverage. Gray grid marks gaps. Viewing angle, grain size, noise and archive filtering affect these uncorrected values; they do not measure ice abundance.
